Messages.Author: gabusanvtes
Messages.Body:
If a vampire success at an "Alastor" political action and choses an
"Inscription" equipment card, can he use the basic or the advanced
version of the Thaumaturgy card? Or would it have no effect?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


If a card that requires a Discipline is played by a means other than the
standard "play" of the card, treat it as if it were brought into play
with the basic version of the Discipline.

However, since Alastor just moves the equipment card from the library to
the vampire, the Inscription winds up in play with no card on
it, so the level of Inscription is moot.
